text: Cream standardised to at least 30 % fat and heat-treated; whippability is the legal requirement.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Whipping is easy at 40 % fat and gets harder at 30 % and below, so a cream that must whip sits in this range.
Whipping cream is heated above roughly 82 to 85 °C for 15 seconds, hot enough to keep it whippable.
It is cooled and held at 4 to 6 °C so the fat crystallises, which is what lets it whip later.
